references.text: A voice cries out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight!
As it is written in the book of the prophet Isaiah: Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way.
In those days John the Baptist came and preached in the wilderness of Judea
There was a man sent from God; his name was John.
He said: I am a voice crying out in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord, as the prophet Isaiah said.
